researchQuestion: Before exposing the frozen private combat-debt package, does the exact current 64-policy cohort contain enough two-carrier acceptance diversity, two-reward opportunity, viability and separate Scoreline and Afterimage separation to justify factor identity work?
claimBoundary: This is a deliberately permissive necessary-capacity upper bound. Passing justifies only research-factor identity preflight. It does not prove that both cards will be offered, acquired, co-held, sequenced or beneficial; failing closes the exact design without implementation or simulator spend.

candidate.poolAndPriorityBoundary: A later acquisition-priority factor may reorder an already acceptable candidate when offered but may not override cardDecline. Pool exposure, payoff and acquisition priority remain unauthorised here.

carrierScoreFormula.selector: Each carrier score is independently greater than or equal to the same policy.cardDecline. addCard and removeCardFromHand receive zero policy score because exact current Pilot has no scorer for either kind.
carrierScoreFormula.joint: A policy is a joint selector only when both frozen carrier scores pass. No package bonus, priority, payoff, outcome, threshold adjustment or learned score is used.

opportunityAndEstimands.twoRewardOpportunity: A row exposes at least two exact normal card-reward records. A policy is robust when this holds in at least two of its four fixed rows.
opportunityAndEstimands.candidatePotentialActive: Joint carrier selector intersect robust two-reward opportunity.
opportunityAndEstimands.exactInactive: Joint nonselector union policies with no two-reward row across all four seeds.
opportunityAndEstimands.ambiguous: Every remaining policy; ambiguous policies cannot count active or inactive.
opportunityAndEstimands.viablePotentialActive: Candidate-potential-active policy with at least one winning row that also has two reward records.
opportunityAndEstimands.separation: Candidate-potential-active is compared separately with the immutable Scoreline and Afterimage policy sets. Neither anchor is combined, pooled or treated as a covariate for the other.

identityGate.rule: The runner must stop before opening either cache unless this exact protocol produced success with zero enabled whole-run and causal rows.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward and economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: Every current row must exactly equal its cached current-main baseline path, RNG, policy and result after only trace and label fields are removed before a score, opportunity or outcome count is read.

cohort.identity: The complete first-look rectangle is fixed. No policy or seed may be added, removed, selected, replaced or given a different endpoint cohort.

sharedAnchors.scorelineDefinition: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
sharedAnchors.afterimageDefinition: At least two of four rows record positive Warden's Edge damage in the identity-proved current trace.

gates.provenance: The 16 active, inactive, opportunity and selector minima; eight viability and two-sided separation minima; 0.75 Jaccard ceiling; and one immutable baseline-fault allowance are frozen on the established 64-policy scale before either cache is opened.

decisionRules.success: Exact source, identity gate, cache, trace and ledger identities pass; both carriers, their joint set, joint inactivity, robust two-reward opportunity, candidate support, exact inactivity, viability, separate two-sided Scoreline and Afterimage separation and reliability pass every frozen gate within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and authorise only a separately preregistered research-factor identity preflight for fixed pool exposure, debt payoff and acquisition priority. Null settings must reproduce exact current-main identity and each enabled setting must change only its named mediator before any enabled whole-run or causal row.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2, close the exact private-combat-debt design and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue 421. Do not change a carrier, value, rarity, token, threshold, cohort, gate or priority rule.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The identity gate, exact cache, source, trace, ledger or deterministic decision cannot complete at the one-attempt 30-second cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and quarantine the exact capacity audit without implementation, another cache, simulator row, proxy, repair, rerun or protected seed; continue scientifically inside issue 421 unless the relevant gate itself is unavailable.
